//: Ward General (wardgeneral) — Data API Builder config. Exposes the same 11 clinical.* stored procedures the Blazor app calls (ADO.NET) as REST + GraphQL, and — because DAB 1.7+/2.0 turns each stored-proc entity marked custom-tool into a named SQL MCP tool — as agent tools. Same procs, three surfaces, no rewrite. DRAFT 2026-07-19 (talk: hyperscale-developer). Verify against DAB 2.0 before deploy.

mcp.description: Ward General (SQL MCP) — clinical stored procedures on Azure SQL Hyperscale, exposed as agent tools.

PatientChart.description: Retrieve the COMPLETE clinical chart for one hospital encounter by EncounterId: patient demographics, diagnoses, active medications, allergies, latest vital signs, recent lab results, symptoms, care team, imaging, recent clinical notes, and regex-extracted note signals. Read-only. Row-Level Security applies: pass ActingProviderId (the acting clinician's id from the security context) so the engine only returns the chart if it's their patient. Use when asked to 'show/open/pull up the chart' or details for a specific encounter.

PatientChartByBed.description: Retrieve the complete clinical chart for the patient CURRENTLY OCCUPYING a given bed (by BedId), for their active encounter. Same rich chart as patient_chart but keyed by bed instead of encounter. Read-only. Row-Level Security applies: pass ActingProviderId (the acting clinician). Use when asked 'who is in bed X' or for the chart of a bed's current patient.

SearchEncounters.description: List/count hospital encounters (admissions) with OPTIONAL filters: Status ('Active' or 'Discharged'), UnitName (e.g. 'ICU A'), DepartmentName (e.g. 'Cardiology'), and ProviderName (attending, partial match). Returns readable encounter summaries (patient name, department, unit, bed, attending, admit/discharge, status), capped by Top (default 200). Read-only. Row-Level Security applies: pass ActingProviderId (the acting clinician) so results are scoped to their patients. Use for questions like 'how many active encounters in ICU A' or 'encounters for Dr. Ward'.

ClinicalAssistance.description: Generate ADVISORY AI clinical assistance for one encounter (by EncounterId): a SUGGESTED triage/acuity flag plus a grounded natural-language summary, produced by retrieval-augmented generation (vector search over similar prior notes) and a reasoning model. Advisory only — a human clinician confirms or overrides; not a diagnosis. Slower (calls gpt-5, ~10-15s) and writes an audited record. Use when asked for an AI assessment, triage suggestion, or summary of a patient's case.

SearchSimilarNotes.description: Semantic (vector) search over ~60,000 historical clinical notes. Given free-text QueryText describing a case, symptom, or condition, returns the TopK most similar notes ranked by similarity score, with note type, encounter id, and note text. Retrieval-only — returns real historical notes, no AI-generated text. Use for 'find similar cases/notes', 'notes about <symptom/condition>', or clinical research lookups.
